columns.name: WORKFLOW_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the workflow

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: This column specifies the workflow version.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: This column differentiates seeded data from customer created.

columns.name: SOURCE_WORKFLOW_ID
columns.description: Identifies parent workflow, if any

columns.name: USE_CASE_ID
columns.description: Identify usecase of the workflow

columns.name: WORKFLOW_CODE
columns.description: Text identifier of the workflow

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: ID of the owner who created the Gen AI Workflow.

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: This column identifies the owner of the workflow.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column provides status of the workflow.

columns.name: ARCHITECTURE
columns.description: Architecture can be hierarchical, group, sequential, etc.

columns.name: ACCESS_MODIFIER
columns.description: Access modifier of the workflow

columns.name: SPECIFICATION
columns.description: JSON specification for the workflow

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Product family of the supported business object.

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.description: Product of the supported business object.

columns.name: HIDDEN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the workflow is visible or not.

columns.name: START_QUESTION_1
columns.description: Slot number one for start question.

columns.name: START_QUESTION_2
columns.description: Slot number two for start question.

columns.name: START_QUESTION_3
columns.description: Slot number three for start question.

columns.name: START_QUESTION_4
columns.description: Slot number four for start question.

columns.name: START_QUESTION_5
columns.description: Slot number five for start question.

columns.name: FOLLOW_UP_PROMPT_ENABLED
columns.description: Whether follow up prompt is enabled.

columns.name: FOLLOW_UP_PROMPT
columns.description: This column stores the follow up prompt.

columns.name: MODEL_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Reference to a LLM model configuration. Foreign key to FAI_MODEL_CONFIGS table.

columns.name: MAX_INTERACTIONS
columns.description: Maximum number of interactions with LLM engine.

columns.name: START_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Start Agent in the associated Agent grapgh.

columns.name: INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: This column represents the system name of the Workflow.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column represents the system description of the Workflow.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CUSTOM_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if customizations have been made to the workflow or not

columns.name: SOURCE_WORKFLOW_CODE
columns.description: Identifies parent workflow code, if any

columns.name: IS_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Identifies if the workflow is a template or not

columns.name: EMAIL_CONFIG_CODE
columns.description: Stores the email account associated with the workflow

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Stores the batch job request identifier

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
